rules.statement: A legatee may maintain an action for the legacy against the executor of the will without alleging or proving the latter's assent to the request, nor need he allege or prove sufficiency of assets in the hands of the executor to meet the request.
rules.supporting_quote: "Neither section 720 (b) of the Civil Procedure Code nor the provisions of the Code for judicial settlement of executors' accounts have the effect of taking away the legatee's right to such action."
